name: Exp_XPeriodCandle_X2
summary: This EA is a two-candle trading system that uses custom XPeriod candle indicators across multiple timeframes to generate trading signals. It compares two consecutive XPeriod candles to determine trend direction and enters positions when both candles align in the same direction, serving as an expert advisor wrapper that orchestrates signal generation and trade execution.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个双K线交易系统，利用跨多个时间框架的自定义XPeriod K线指标生成交易信号。它通过比较两根连续的XPeriod K线来判断趋势方向，当两根K线方向一致时开仓，作为信号生成和交易执行的专家顾问封装器运行。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于XPeriod自定义周期K线的双K线确认模式，通过比较两根连续的XPeriod K线的开收关系来判断市场方向。入场条件为当第一根XPeriod K线和第二根XPeriod K线同方向收盘（均为看涨或均为看跌）时，分别在两个时间框架上确认后开仓做多或做空。出场条件依赖反向信号的出现，即当XPeriod K线序列出现反向排列时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，通过输入参数设定交易量，没有动态加仓或减仓机制。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数，但核心依赖信号反转平仓，缺少基于波动率的动态止损计算。整体策略属于多周期趋势确认型系统，利用双时间框架的K线方向一致性过滤假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual-candle confirmation pattern using custom XPeriod candles, determining market direction by comparing the open-close relationships of two consecutive XPeriod candles. Entry conditions require that both the first and second XPeriod candles close in the same direction (both bullish or both bearish), with confirmation across two timeframes before opening a long or short position. Exit conditions rely on the appearance of a reverse signal, meaning positions are closed when the XPeriod candle sequence shows an opposing arrangement. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with the trade volume set through input parameters, lacking any dynamic position increase or decrease mechanism. In terms of money management, the EA provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters, but the core exit relies on signal reversal rather than volatility-based dynamic stop calculations. Overall, this is a multi-timeframe trend confirmation system that uses directional consistency of candles across dual timeframes to filter out false signals.

parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: XPeriod1
parameters.description: 第一时间框架XPeriod指标周期参数
parameters.description_en: XPeriod indicator period for first timeframe

parameters.name: XPeriod2
parameters.description: 第二时间框架XPeriod指标周期参数
parameters.description_en: XPeriod indicator period for second timeframe

pros: 双时间框架确认机制有效过滤单周期假信号，提高入场质量
XPeriod自定义周期K线比传统时间框架更灵活，能适应不同市场节奏
双K线确认逻辑简单清晰，便于理解和回测验证
pros_en: Dual-timeframe confirmation mechanism effectively filters single-timeframe false signals, improving entry quality
XPeriod custom-period candles are more flexible than traditional timeframes, adapting to different market rhythms
Dual-candle confirmation logic is simple and clear, making it easy to understand and backtest
cons: 固定手数仓位管理缺乏灵活性，未根据账户资金或波动率动态调整
默认止损止盈为零，存在未设止损直接交易的风险
仅依赖信号反转出场，在剧烈行情中可能导致较大回撤
cons_en: Fixed lot position sizing lacks flexibility, with no dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility
Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, creating risk of trading without protective stops
Relying solely on signal reversal for exits can lead to significant drawdowns during volatile market conditions
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈计算，根据市场波动率自适应调整保护水平
加入资金管理模块，根据账户余额和风险比例自动计算最优交易手数
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit calculation to adapt protection levels to market volatility
Implement a money management module that automatically calculates optimal lot size based on account balance and risk ratio

risk_points: 默认止损止盈参数为零，若用户忘记设置则无保护性止损
出场完全依赖信号反转，缺乏最大回撤限制或时间止损机制
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit parameters are zero, leaving no protective stops if the user forgets to configure them
Exits rely entirely on signal reversal, lacking maximum drawdown limits or time-based stop mechanisms

It compares two consecutive XPeriod candles to determine trend direction and enters positions when both candles align in the same direction, serving as an expert advisor wrapper that orchestrates signal generation and trade execution.
